assertions.assertion: Adds or references the Duende.IdentityServer.Configuration.EntityFramework NuGet package
assertions.rationale: Adds Duende.IdentityServer.Configuration.EntityFramework via dotnet add package and a .csproj PackageReference.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddClientConfigurationStore() on the IdentityServer configuration builder
Warns against using in-memory stores for dynamically registered clients in production
assertions.rationale: Explicitly warns not to use in-memory stores in production because registered clients are lost on restart and not shared across instances.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT suggest implementing IClientConfigurationStore from scratch when the EF package is available
assertions.rationale: Recommends the shipped EF store and only mentions a custom implementation for backing stores the EF package does not cover.
